Remaining: bread, onion, peanut butter, salad, sushi.

I want a question that splits these five as evenly as possible.

"Is it spread on other food?" would only isolate peanut butter (1 vs 4).

"Is it a whole meal on its own?" gives salad and sushi (maybe) against the other three, a 2/3 split.

"Is it made mostly from flour or grain?" gives bread, and maybe sushi (rice), which is also about 2/3, but it is ambiguous for sushi.

"Is it usually eaten raw?" gives onion, salad, and maybe sushi, against bread and peanut butter. That is ambiguous for sushi too.

"Is it a vegetable?" gives onion, and maybe salad.

"Is it usually kept in the fridge?" is unclear for several of them.

"Is it a whole meal on its own?" is the cleanest split, so I'll use it.
